purpose: English, flat 2D GitHub README and social sharing cover.
direction: Warm paper, ink, cobalt, a flat modular F and large geometric typography. No construction guides, decorative point, 3D illustration, extrusion, gradients or shadows.
method: Original vector composition using the existing authoritative Forma symbol. Editable SVG embeds Manrope; PNGs rasterized with Sharp from glyph outlines produced by fontTools to avoid font substitution.
review: English copy, flat geometry, symbol proportions, font rendering, safe margins and full-size composition visually inspected. Essential messaging is repeated in accessible README text. The existing 3D assets elsewhere in the skill package are outside this cover/README change.
